stories.title: Purnea MP Pappu Yadav attacks Bageshwar Dham priest:Calls Dhirendra Shastri thief swindler, questions his statements on nationalism caste, and religion in public debate
stories.summary: Purnia MP Pappu Yadav has called Madhya Pradesh's Bageshwar Dham's Peethadheeshwar Dhirendra Shastri a thief and swindler. He said, 'Who is this Dhirendra Shastri?' When journalists said he is a storyteller, Pappu Yadav said, 'You are making a thief and swindler into a storyteller, is he Osho, is he Acharya Ramamurti?' Actually, at Patna airport, when a journalist asked him about Dhirendra Shastri's recent statement (if the moon comes on tricolor, the country will not remain safe), the MP got angry. Further said, 'That one Baba of ours who is very lovely, who always keeps smiling, Premanand Baba. Respect such Babas. This thief-swindler, who has nothing to do with Sanatan, knows nothing about Sanatan; you talk about him.' Taunt on Vrindavan's storyteller Indresh Upadhyay Purnea MP also targeted Vrindavan's famous storyteller Indresh Upadhyay, along with Dhirendra Shastri. On December 5, storyteller Indresh Upadhyay married Shipra Sharma from Haryana in Jaipur, Rajasthan. A lot of money was spent on this wedding. 500 VIPs, including Pandit Dhirendra Shastri and poet Kumar Vishwas, attended this. Regarding this, Pappu Yadav said, 'There is a Baba worth 300 crores, who just got married in Rajasthan. Let India follow Krishna's path, let it follow Guru Nanak's path, let it follow Buddha's path, let it become Ambedkarite. Why are you people making India follow these fraudulent ways?' The wedding mandap was built in the style of Tirupati Balaji Temple Storyteller Indresh Upadhyay got married in Jaipur. Where 101 priests from Haridwar, Nasik, and Vrindavan performed the wedding rituals and ceremonies according to Vedic traditions. The main wedding ceremonies lasted for about 3 hours. Storyteller Devi Chitralekha attended with her husband at the wedding mandap built in the style of Tirupati Balaji Temple. Additionally, Sadhvi Ritambhara, Acharya Punderik Goswami, Sanjeev Krishna Shastri, and Mahant Raju Das of Ayodhya Hanumangarhi, along with many saints and celebrities, attended this wedding. Now know that statement of Pandit Dhirendra Shastri, over which question MPs got angry Let us tell you that recently, RSS's centenary Hindu conference was held in Banda, UP. Where Pandit Dhirendra Krishna Shastri had said, 'The day the moon comes in the tricolour, neither Sharma will survive, nor Verma will survive, neither Kshatriya will survive, nor Ravidas followers will survive, nor will Tulsidas followers survive, meaning no Hindu will survive.' Bageshwar Dham Sarkar also said that 'Today the country needs nationalism, not casteism. Dhirendra Shastri further said that if Hindus remain divided into castes, society will have to bear its loss.' Know what MP Pappu Yadav has previously said about Dhirendra Shastri MP has also called Dhirendra Shastri a ruffian MP Pappu Yadav has previously attacked storyteller Pandit Dhirendra Shastri. In a YouTube channel podcast, Pappu Yadav referred to Dhirendra Shastri as a 'ruffian' while mentioning his name. He said that today, many such people have emerged in society who are misleading people by using religious platforms. Such babas should drown themselves During the Kumbh Mela in Uttar Pradesh, storyteller Pandit Dhirendra Shastri's statement after the death of several devotees in a stampede incident created a major controversy. After the accident, Dhirendra Shastri had said that dying at Kumbh leads to salvation. His statement faced anger from opposition parties and social organisations. Pappu Yadav had strongly protested against this statement in Parliament. Attacking Dhirendra Shastri, Pappu Yadav had said, 'Such Babas and people connected with money and politics should drown themselves.' He had said that the people who died in the stampede were poor and helpless, and it is inhuman to justify their deaths by calling it salvation.

stories.title: AAP protests in Lucknow over temple demolition in Kashi:Police detain leaders, drag workers into buses, and take them to Eco Garden after heated clash protest
stories.summary: Aam Aadmi Party held a strong protest in Lucknow against the demolition of ancient temples at Manikarnika Ghat in Kashi. They had a heated argument with the police. Police dragged and carried AAP leaders and workers to put them in buses. They were taken to Eco Garden. Party's District General Secretary Gyan Singh Kushwaha said that this government wants to erase our history. The government is destroying old temples. It is directly attacking our culture. This government is building its new empire. This is a completely anti-Hindu government. See 3 pictures of the protest... Protest held on state in-charge's direction District officials conducted this protest at the direction of the party's state in-charge MP Sanjay Singh. AAP says this matter is not just about construction or development, but is connected to faith, tradition, and respect for cultural heritage. The party alleged that tampering with religious sites in the name of development is not acceptable, and accountability will be fixed for those responsible. Demand for fixing accountability Party leaders said that Manikarnika Ghat is an important symbol of Kashi's identity and Sanatan tradition. Any kind of demolition of ancient temples here has hurt people's religious sentiments. AAP has demanded an impartial investigation of the entire matter and strict action against the culprits from the administration.

stories.title: Chaos and vandalism in Delhi Police Recruitment Exam in Kanpur:Exam cancelled due to server fault; candidates broke computers and doors
stories.summary: There was a huge uproar during the Delhi Police recruitment examination at MGA College in Purwamir, under the Maharajpur police station area of Kanpur, on Tuesday. Angry candidates vandalised parts of the college after the examination was cancelled due to a server failure. As the situation went out of control, the authorities cancelled the exam in all three shifts. According to the candidates, the first shift exam was scheduled to begin at 9 am, with entry starting from 8:45 am. However, even after the scheduled time, the main gate of the college was not opened. Hundreds of candidates waiting outside grew restless and began protesting. The college management asked students to wait, citing technical issues with the server. Candidates alleged that till around 10:30 am, neither was any written notice displayed nor was clear information provided regarding the cancellation of the exam. The lack of communication and prolonged delay further escalated the anger among the students. Police later reached the spot to control the situation, and the matter is being looked into. Vandalism at main gate and server room As the situation deteriorated, hundreds of candidates broke through the college's main gate and entered the premises. Students broke the server room gate as well and damaged the systems installed there, alleging malpractice in the examination process. Upon receiving information about the incident, Narwal SDM Vivek Kumar Mishra and ACP Chakeri Abhishek Kumar Pandey reached the spot with the Police force. The officials managed to calm down the candidates through persuasion and brought the situation under control. All three shifts of exam cancelled Due to chaos and technical issues, all three shifts of the Delhi Police recruitment exam to be held at the MGA College centre were cancelled. This forced thousands of candidates who came from far-off places to return disappointed. No official statement has come from the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) or officials related to exam conduct regarding the entire matter. Candidates say that this situation arose due to a lack of timely information and inadequate arrangements. After the incident, questions have been raised about the arrangements and technical preparations at the examination center. Candidates have demanded that the new date for the cancelled exam should be announced soon and solid arrangements should be made to prevent such mismanagement in the future.

stories.title: Minor girl abducted and gangraped by cousins in Kanpur:held captive overnight; police launch probe after victim flees at dawn
stories.summary: A 13-year-old girl was gang-raped late on Monday night in a village within the Bilhaur police station area of Kanpur after being abducted by two cousins who lived in her neighbourhood. The teenager was seized while stepping out of her home to answer a call of nature and was held captive overnight before managing to escape and return to her family early on Tuesday morning. Girl goes missing at night, found at daybreak According to a written complaint filed by the victim’s mother, the girl had left the house on Monday night but failed to return. Concerned family members conducted a search of the area throughout the night but were unable to locate her. The teenager eventually returned home at dawn in a visibly distressed state and narrated the events to her parents. Minor allegedly gagged and taken to accused’s residence The report alleges that the accused gagged the victim by stuffing a cloth into her mouth to silence her before dragging her to their residence nearby. The assault reportedly took place in a room situated on the second floor of the house. Accused cousins detained Local police responded promptly to the scene and have detained both accused cousins, transporting them to the local Kotwali (main police station). Inspector Sudhir Kumar confirmed that authorities have received information regarding the incident and that a preliminary enquiry is underway. He stated that a formal case will be registered and legal action taken following the conclusion of the investigation.

stories.title: LLB student shot dead over mobile installment dispute:Assailants fired to kill advocate in Bareilly, bullet claims life of younger brother
stories.summary: An LLB student was shot dead in Nawada Bilsandi village under the Faridpur police station area after attackers allegedly opened fire to kill his lawyer brother over a dispute related to non-payment of a mobile phone installment. The deceased has been identified as Yogesh Yadav (21), a fifth-semester LLB student at Classic Law College, Bareilly. The incident occurred late Monday evening, a short distance from the family’s house. According to police and family members, the attackers were lying in wait and fired at advocate Dhirendra Yadav, but the bullet struck his younger brother Yogesh, who was returning home with him on a motorcycle after appearing for his LLB examination. Yogesh was rushed to the hospital in a critical condition, where doctors declared him dead on arrival. Ambushed near home, bullet hits LLB student Yogesh’s father Ompal Singh, a farmer, has four sons—Pramod (eldest), advocate Manoj Yadav, Dhirendra Yadav, and the youngest, Yogesh. According to advocate Dhirendra, on Monday evening Yogesh had completed his LLB 5th semester examination and was returning home with him on a motorcycle. As they reached near their house in the village, attackers who were already lying in wait allegedly opened fire with the intention of killing Dhirendra. The bullet struck Yogesh in the abdomen, causing him to fall on the road. During the incident, both brothers fell from the motorcycle. Hearing their cries, the third brother, advocate Manoj Yadav, rushed to the spot and confronted the assailants. The attackers allegedly assaulted Manoj and Dhirendra before fleeing the scene on motorcycles. Student died due to excessive bleeding Villagers gathered at the scene and helped take Yogesh and Dhirendra to the hospital. Doctors declared Yogesh dead, stating that excessive bleeding from a bullet wound in the abdomen led to his death. Lawyers demand arrest Following the incident, lawyers reached the police station and the hospital late at night, demanding the immediate arrest of the accused. They said that if lawyers and students are not safe, the condition of ordinary citizens can only be worse. The lawyers warned of an agitation if arrests were not made within 24 hours. Police officials assured them of strict action, after which the protest subsided. CO Sandeep Singh and Faridpur SHO Chaman Singh visited the spot to investigate. Police said three teams have been formed to trace and arrest the accused. Loaned mobile at root of deadly attack According to villagers, advocate Dhirendra had purchased a mobile phone on loan using the Aadhaar card of PK, son of Ram Avatar, who is the brother of village head Raees. Dhirendra allegedly failed to pay the installments. When PK demanded payment, Dhirendra refused. Enraged over this dispute, PK, along with his associates, allegedly fired at Dhirendra, but the bullet struck Yogesh instead, leading to his death. SP South says - Accused will be arrested soon SP South Anshika Verma said that Yogesh Yadav, a student, was shot dead in the incident. Sumit, Ram Khiladi, and PK have been named as accused, and an FIR has been registered against them. One accused has been taken into custody for questioning. As a precautionary measure, additional police force has been deployed in the village, and teams are conducting raids at possible hideouts to arrest the remaining accused. ------------------------------------------- this news- Girlfriend cut into pieces, kept in blue box: In Jhansi, he was burning one body part each day for 7 days, fled with box in auto In Jhansi, a boyfriend murdered his girlfriend. He cut the body into pieces. The retired railway employee was burning one body part each day for 7 days to dispose of the body. Later, he was going to dispose of the half-burnt body parts, bones and ashes packed in a blue box. Read full story... ...................

stories.title: Magh Mela authority issues notice to Avimukteshwaranand:Asks him to prove he is the ‘real’ Shankaracharya within 24 hours; seer sitting on Dharna for 3 days
stories.summary: The Magh Mela administration in Prayagraj has issued a notice to Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand after he staged a protest over his chariot being stopped. The Mela Authority has asked him to prove within 24 hours that he is the legitimate Shankaracharya. At around midnight on Monday, Kanungo Anil Kumar reached the Shankaracharya’s camp at the Magh Mela to serve the notice. His disciples refused to accept it, saying no one was available at that hour and asked him to return in the morning. On Tuesday morning, Anil Kumar visited the camp again and pasted the notice at the gate. The notice was issued on behalf of the Vice-Chairman of the Mela Authority. Reference to SC orders The notice states that the dispute over the Shankaracharya post is currently pending before the Supreme Court. On 14 October 2022, the Court ordered that until a final verdict is delivered, no one can be declared Shankaracharya, nor can any Pattaabhishek be performed. The Court has clearly barred anyone from occupying the post, and no fresh order has been issued so far. Despite this, during the Magh Mela, Avimukteshwaranand displayed a board at his camp identifying himself as ‘Shankaracharya of Jyotish Peeth’, which the Mela Authority says violates the Supreme Court’s order. Shankaracharya refuses to back down Avimukteshwaranand has stated that he will not enter the ashram until the administration apologises. In a press conference on Monday, he said he would continue coming to Prayagraj for every fair but would stay on the pavement instead of the camp. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav also spoke to him over the phone on Monday evening, assuring support and saying he would meet him soon. Dispute on Mauni Amavasya The controversy began on Mauni Amavasya, when police stopped the Shankaracharya’s palanquin and asked him to proceed on foot to the Sangam. His disciples objected and tried to move the palanquin forward, leading to scuffles with the police. Several disciples were detained, prompting the Shankaracharya to stage a sit-in demanding their release. Tensions persisted for nearly two hours, after which more supporters were detained. The palanquin was dragged about one kilometre away from the Sangam, during which a part of it broke. The Shankaracharya was unable to perform the ritual bath. stories.title: Brijbhushan says, 'I passed class 8 by cheating':Former MP turns emotional while visiting school in Gorakhpur
stories.summary: Former MP Brijbhushan Sharan Singh shared candid memories from his student life during a visit to Chauri Chaura in Gorakhpur on Monday. Recalling his early struggles, he said he failed Class 8 twice and passed the third attempt by cheating-an incident that left him so guilty he could not sleep the entire night. He said that at the time, his maternal uncle Sarvadanand Singh was working in the sugarcane department in Chauri Chaura. When he asked if there was a school nearby, his uncle said yes. The very next morning, Brijbhushan came to Chauri Chaura, a place that later shaped his life. Lived in a godown for four years Brijbhushan said he lived in a godown premises for four years before getting admission to Mahajan Inter College. He completed his studies up to intermediate while staying in Chauri Chaura and said the town is deeply connected to his life journey. Drawing a comparison with Hindu mythology, he said that just as Vrindavan holds a special place in Lord Krishna’s life, Chauri Chaura holds the same importance in his own life. He added that just as Chitrakoot is significant in Lord Ram’s life, Chauri Chaura has a similar place for him. Event at JB Maharaj Degree College An event was organised at JB Maharaj Degree College in the Chauri Chaura area on Monday, where Brijbhushan Sharan Singh attended as the chief guest. The former MP and former president of the Wrestling Federation of India arrived at the college campus by helicopter and addressed students along with his old friends. While speaking to students, he shared experiences from his student life and motivated the youth to move forward. He said he had learned many life lessons in Chauri Chaura and had come to pay tribute to the land where he struggled and shaped his future. Stay connected to your roots Addressing the youth, Brijbhushan stressed the importance of staying connected to one’s roots. He said that just as a tree remains green when connected to the soil, people should stay connected to their village, parents and values. He told the people of Chauri Chaura that the town is like his own home and assured them that if they ever needed his support or service, they should not hesitate to reach out to him. Student life shapes identity Brijbhushan told students that it is during student life that one learns to distinguish between right and wrong. Referring to his own journey, he said that he once studied while living in a small room, and today he returned to the same place by helicopter. Emotional visit to old room After the programme, Brijbhushan visited the room where he had lived and studied from Class 8 to Class 12. Touching the walls of the room, he became emotional as old memories came flooding back, and his eyes welled up with tears. He also met his old friends and shared memories of those days. Wrestling days in Chauri Chaura He recalled that his friend Ramchandra Pahalwan had opened a wrestling arena where he used to practise. He said good company and good friends play a crucial role in giving the right direction to life. According to him, a person’s identity begins to take shape during their student years. Brijbhushan said he first came to Chauri Chaura in 1972 and, despite early failures, the town helped him rebuild his confidence and determine his path forward — a journey he continues to value deeply.

stories.title: Defeated BJP leader's name on plaque in Lucknow:Names of party's Metropolitan and Mandal Presidents also written; Officials say everything will be removed
stories.summary: BJP's mandal and metropolitan level leaders' names are shining more than public representatives in Lucknow's development works. Many development work plaques display the names of MP Rajnath Singh, Mayor Sushma Kharkwal, along with the metropolitan president and mandal president. Not only this, those who have lost corporator elections have gotten their names written on works done through MP funds. Actually, Rajya Sabha MP and former mayor Dinesh Sharma inaugurated several interlocking and road works worth one crore rupees on January 18. For this, all the plaques were combined and garlanded together. What was surprising during this was that some plaques showed the names of people who are not public representatives. Officials have said they will stop this new trend. A plaque mentioned the construction of the CC road from Abhay's house to Shivnarayan's shop, from Anil's house to Rani Katra main road, and from Munna's house to Sharad's house. It also had the names and party positions of BJP Metropolitan President Anand Dwivedi and Lucknow Division President Daya Pandey written on it. Lucknow's Chief Development Officer, Ajay Jain, said - These names will be removed. BJP Metropolitan District President's name on the board CC road is to be constructed in Kaliji ward in the square. Its foundation stone was also laid, which is being built from his fund. The board includes the names of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Rajya Sabha MP Dinesh Sharma, Mayor Sushma Kharkwal, MLA Neeraj Bora and Councilor Anurag Mishra Annu, but two surprising names are also written on the board. These names were - BJP Metropolitan President Anand Dwivedi and BJP's District President Daya Pandey. Neither of these two are public representative. Former councilor's name in work done through MP fund In Ismailganj, RCC road and drain construction work near Anandeshwar Temple, Hariharnagar, has been done using MP Rajnath Singh's fund. The board installed here bears the name of Krishna Veer Singh Bantu, a former BJP councillor. In this context, Congress councillor Mukesh Singh Chauhan from the ward has raised questions. He said that BJP leaders' names are being written on plaques for foundation laying and inaugurations happening at various places, whereas only party leaders' names should be written on these. 'SIR is a ritual, parties remember Brahmins during elections' After laying the foundation stone for development works, Rajya Sabha MP, former Deputy CM, and former Mayor Dr. Dinesh Sharma spoke about SIR. He said - This process is like a sacred ritual. We have told workers that if their name is registered in SIR, consider it as an offering in the sacred fire. Meanwhile, on former CM Mayawati's statement about Brahmins, he said - Political parties remember Brahmins only before elections. Before this, they kept abusing Brahmins and deities. If these people ever visit temples, then they understand that they are well-wishers of Brahmins.

stories.title: Cyber fraud in Lucknow increased 5 times in 4 years:Fraud of over 76 crores in a year; Cyber commandos deployed, working like SPG-NSG
stories.summary: Cases of cyber fraud in Lucknow have increased 5-fold in 4 years. In 2022, only 42 cases were registered at the cyber police station, which increased to 215 in 2025. In 2025, cyber fraudsters cheated people of Rs 76 crore 50 lakh. However, the police have also managed to recover Rs 54 crore 20 lakh through their actions. Cyber commandos have been prepared to protect people from cyber fraud and help victims recover their money. Cyber commandos have been deployed in all three zones of the Lucknow Police Commissionerate. These cyber commandos are equipped with modern equipment and advanced cyber technology. Training received from IIT experts DCP Crime Kamlesh Dixit said that the 15-member cyber commando team has been trained by experts from prestigious institutions like IIT Kanpur, Raipur, Madras and National Defence University, along with cyber experts from Gujarat. During the training, they were taught how to technically prevent cybercrime. How to trace cyber criminals when crimes occur, and how to recover fraudulent amounts. The team has also been provided with several modern tools for this purpose. Cyber sector commandos will be like SPG-NSG Kamlesh Dixit said that just as SPG and NSG commandos are proficient in their respective fields, cyber commandos are also fully capable in the cyber sector. This trained team is providing training to police personnel at the zone level, so that cyber commandos can be deployed at every level in the coming time. This will make the investigation of cybercrime cases faster and more effective. Kamlesh Dixit said that cyber fraud, online cyber attacks, social media crimes, data theft, phishing, digital blackmailing and digital arrests are increasing rapidly. The role of expert cyber commandos is considered very important in these cases, who will take solid action with technical expertise. Cyber commandos are police personnel who are fully trained to deal with cyber challenges. These are police personnel above the rank of head constable. The government is very sensitive considering the large-scale cyber fraud, and for this reason, cyber commandos have been appointed and trained in the state. Fraud in the name of investment has increased DCP Kamlesh Dixit said that new methods of cyber fraud are emerging at the current time. Fraudsters extort money by scaring, threatening or luring people. Especially, fraud in the name of investment has increased rapidly. In which fraudsters pose as girls on social media and lure people with promises of high profits. To deal with these challenges, the state government and Uttar Pradesh Police are appointing and continuously training cyber commandos, so that strict action can be ensured against cyber criminals. Now read some major fraud cases that happened in 2025... Vikasnagar resident Anil Kumar Dwivedi said that on June 5, 2025, he received a message on Telegram from ID JUCVJRG. It talked about earning huge profits through crypto trading. After the conversation, the victim was added to a Telegram group called Google eecutes917 group. People in the group started instigating to increase investment. Falling for their words, he deposited a total of 60 lakh rupees through the links provided by the fraudsters, which were not returned. He complained about this to the police. 80-year-old elderly person cheated by showing fear of money laundering Singar Nagar Alambagh resident 80-year-old Om Prakash Narayan Mishra is a retired Deputy General Manager (DGM) of UPPCL. He said that on November 11, around 12 noon, he received a WhatsApp audio call from an unknown number. The caller identified himself as a CBI officer. He said - A bank account has been opened with your Aadhar number, in which money laundering has taken place. Within a short time, a copy of the arrest warrant was also sent to their WhatsApp. Upon seeing the warrant copy, they became worried. Meanwhile, the caller pressured them to join a video call. On the video call, the fraudster wearing a uniform said the case would be heard in the Mumbai High Court. After this, they were cheated out of 47 lakh rupees in two days in the name of an investigation. Cheated of 19.83 lakhs in the name of opening a petrol pump Sector-K Aliganj resident Ambika Pratap Singh said that he registered on the website jiobpromlbpdealership.in, found on Google on October 26. After this, on November 4, he received an email from jiobp@rbmlbpdealership.in on his email ID to confirm the dealership. In which some documents were requested. After submitting the documents, they asked for money in the name of a processing fee. The victim first sent five thousand rupees online. After that, 19.83 lakh rupees were deposited in Axis Bank account through RTGS. Contact with the fraudsters continued through WhatsApp and calls. A few days later when he inquired from the bank, he found out that the given account belongs to Jalaun district. After this, when he called the fraudster's mobile number, the phone was switched off. Kept under digital arrest for 6 days claiming Pakistan connection Janakipuram resident Gaya Prasad is a retired teacher. He said that he received a call on his mobile on November 7. The caller identified himself as Inspector Ranjit Kumar from ATS Department, Lucknow Police Headquarters. The caller said that your number was found in a money laundering case connected to Pakistan. Mentioning the name of Afzal Khan from Delhi, he informed that your number is with Pakistani handlers and your name is included in case number JK19282015. The caller threatened that you could be immediately arrested and sent to jail, but I can save you. For this, an NOC needs to be obtained. After that, he asked the victim to provide information about all bank accounts and transfer money to different accounts and UPI IDs. He also instructed not to tell anything to family members and the bank. Under pressure from the fraudsters, the victim transferred a total of 12 lakh 57 thousand rupees from three different accounts.

stories.title: More lives lost in road accidents than COVID-19:Transport Minister Dayashankar says, 'Getting license abroad is difficult, easy in India'
stories.summary: A two-day workshop on road safety began on Monday at Visvesvaraya Hall in Lucknow. Experts were invited to raise awareness about road safety among transport and related department officials who came from across state for the campaign. The program was inaugurated by Minister of State for Transport (Independent Charge) Dayashankar Singh. More accidents in expressways and large state Minister Dayashankar Singh said that UP is a large state and the expressway network here has grown rapidly. For this reason, there is also more pressure from road accidents. This training is being given to prevent these accidents and reduce the death rate. He informed that after the training, all officers will prepare detailed reports of their respective areas, so that concrete efforts can be made to prevent accidents on the state's roads. After No helmet no fuel, now 2 helmet rule Strict licensing system, instructions to increase monitoring During the programme, the minister also mentioned the challenges of the department. He said that getting a driving license is considered one of the most difficult tasks in foreign countries, while it is relatively easier in India. He clarified that issuing licenses just to increase numbers is not right; licenses should only be given to those who are fully trained. He informed that errors related to learning licenses are being corrected and officials have been instructed to maintain strict monitoring wherever permanent licenses are being issued. stories.title: Man kills 4 family members, then takes his own life:Accused shoots wife, two sons, and mother in forehead; fires twice at himself
stories.summary: Saharanpur witnessed a shocking family tragedy when a government employee, Ameen, allegedly shot dead his wife, two sons and mother before killing himself. The incident took place in Shashwat Vihar Colony of the Sarsawa police station area. According to the police, Ashok Rathore (40), who was posted as an ameen in the irrigation department, first shot his family members in the forehead and then fired at his own chest and head. Five bodies were found inside the house. Ashok and his wife were lying on the floor, while the bodies of his mother and two children were found on the bed. Three country-made pistols were recovered from near Ashok’s body. The incident came to light when Ashok’s brother-in-law tried to contact him several times over the phone on Tuesday morning. When the calls went unanswered, he sent his son to Ashok’s house. After repeated knocks received no response, so he broke a window and entered the house, where he found all five bodies in a locked room. District Magistrate Manish Bansal and SSP Ashish Tiwari reached the spot after receiving information. A forensic team also inspected the crime scene, and all five bodies were sent for post-mortem examination. During preliminary inquiry, police learned that Ashok was suffering from depression and was undergoing treatment in Chandigarh. SSP Ashish Tiwari said the initial investigation suggests that Ashok shot his family members first and then ended his own life. The exact reason behind the extreme step is still under investigation. The deceased have been identified as Ashok Rathore, his wife Anjita (37), his mother Vidyawati (70), and his two sons Kartik (16) and Dev (13). Kartik was studying in Class 10 at an inter-college in Nakur, while Dev was a Class 9 student at a private school in the town. Ashok had got the job of Ameen on compassionate grounds after his father’s death. He was posted at Nakur tehsil and had rented a two-storey house in Shashwat Vihar Colony around five months ago. The family lived on the second floor of the house. As news of the incident spread, relatives and neighbours gathered at the spot. Anjita’s sister reached the house and broke down inconsolably. The atmosphere in the locality remained tense as people struggled to come to terms with the tragedy. Police officials said further investigation is underway to ascertain the circumstances and motive behind the incident.

stories.title: Nitin Nabin set to take center stage in UP politics:'Agnipariksha' before 2027 elections, challenge to prove himself in front of BJP leaders
stories.summary: Nitin Nabin’s elevation to national president of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is expected to bring significant changes to the political landscape and strategy in Uttar Pradesh. From forming the state BJP team to overseeing Panchayat elections, Rajya Sabha and Legislative Council polls, and eventually the 2027 Assembly elections, he will play a central role in strategy and candidate selection. Nominations for the BJP national president election were completed on Monday. The formal announcement will elevate Nitin Nabin from working president to national president. Uttar Pradesh will be the most important state under his leadership. The 2027 Assembly elections in UP will be a major test not only for Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and state president Pankaj Chaudhary, but also for Nitin Nabin. Analysts note that he will need to develop a thorough understanding of the state’s political dynamics and leadership. Nitin Nabin is expected to soon consult with CM Yogi Adityanath, Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, state president Pankaj Chaudhary, General Secretary (Organisation) Dharampal Singh, and other ministers and MPs regarding UP’s political scenario. Only then will he actively participate in political activities and finalise the election agenda. Key role in forming new state team BJP’s state team under Pankaj Chaudhary will undergo restructuring, with new regional presidents to be appointed in Awadh, Kashi, Braj, West, Gorakhpur, and Kanpur regions. State presidents of Morchas, including Mahila, Yuva, Kisan, OBC, SC, ST, and Minority, will also be appointed. Decisions on organisational appointments, including who retains positions and which new faces emerge, will be guided by Nitin Nabin. Trial by fire for Nitin Nabin Senior journalist Anand Rai observes that while BJP decision-making is collective, the national president plays a pivotal role. Being from neighbouring Bihar, Nitin Nabin is expected to understand UP politics but will face challenges from Panchayat elections to the 2027 Assembly elections. He must assess political equations and take strategic decisions, making this role a trial by fire. UP leaders, ministers, MPs, and MLAs will now need to prove their capabilities before Nitin Nabin. Previously, outgoing national president JP Nadda maintained a strong grip on UP politics, making informed decisions about leaders’ strengths. Now, politicians must improve their image and performance to secure their positions. Consolidating the Kayastha Vote Bank Political analysts note that the Kayastha community represents about one per cent of UP’s population, with five MLAs. Historically, the community’s presence in the BJP’s state organisation was limited. With Nitin Nabin from the Kayastha community assuming a top position, the community receives recognition and the BJP can strengthen its vote bank. State media co-contact chief Naveen Srivastava stated that the Kayastha community previously felt underrepresented despite full support for the party. With Nitin Nabin’s appointment, the community will receive a clear message of recognition, positively impacting UP, as well as BJP prospects in West Bengal and Assam. Nitin Nabin’s leadership is expected to shape party strategy, candidate selection, and organisational reforms, reinforcing BJP’s political influence in Uttar Pradesh and beyond.

stories.title: BJP leader accused of killing wife in Ambedkarnagar:Police say teacher was murdered at home over suspicion of illicit relations, husband detained
stories.summary: A BJP leader killed his wife by slitting her throat on suspicion of illicit relations in Ambedkarnagar. The blood-soaked body of the woman was found in the kitchen. She was alone at home at the time of the incident. When the mother-in-law returned home, she discovered the incident. She called and informed the police. When the police arrived at the scene and started an investigation, the husband's name came up. Police have taken the accused husband, Umashankar Singh, into custody and are interrogating him. He is the BJP's city media in-charge. The wife was a teacher in a private school. The incident took place at Gandhi Ashram inthe Akbarpur police station area. SO Srinivas Pandey said that the husband killed his wife on suspicion of illicit relations. He used to say that neither of the children was his. Vrishbhan Singh, a resident of Madar Bhari village in the Bhiti police station area, lives with his family in Akbarpur Gandhi Ashram. Vrishbhan Singh was the manager in the dyeing department at Akbarpur Gandhi Ashram. He retired in 2014. His son, Umashankar Singh, and daughter-in-law Soni Singh (33) also lived with them. Umashankar is the city media in-charge of the BJP. He also operated his JCB machine. His wife, Soni Singh, was a teacher in a private school. Soni has two children, Sanidhya Singh (12) and Samar Singh (10). On Monday morning at 10 AM, Soni sent the children to school. During that time, mother-in-law Malti Singh went to the shop to buy household items. Around 11 AM, father-in-law Vrishbhan also went to court for some work. Soni was alone at home. During this time, taking advantage of the opportunity, her husband killed her by slitting her throat. When mother-in-law Malti returned at 12:30, she saw Soni's blood-soaked body in the kitchen. She started crying and screaming. She immediately called Vrishbhan. After hearing the sound of crying, neighbors who arrived at the scene informed the police. After this, the Akbarpur police reached the spot. The body was sent for a post-mortem. The crime scene was investigated. The forensic team collected evidence from there. SP Abhijeet R. Shankar said that today they received information about a woman's death at Gandhi Ashram. After this, Kotwali police reached the spot. There, Soni Singh's body was found with a slit throat in the kitchen. Based on the initial investigation, the woman's husband has been taken into custody and is being interrogated.

stories.title: Police brutality claim sparks protest by Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand:Sadhu recounts hair pulling, baton blows, and kicks inside Prayagraj police station during Mauni Amavasya
stories.summary: Our Jagat Guru arrived at the Sangam. I am a Brahmachari, so I was carrying a staff. I was walking ahead of Guruji. The police snatched our staff. They grabbed my hair and tossed me around like a washerman tosses clothes. After this, they beat us severely with the same staff. They hit us with shoes. Despite all this, I kept folding my hands before the police. These are the words of Brahmachari Sadhu Vishravanand, who was dragged into the police station by the police on Mauni Amavasya and then beaten with kicks, shoes, and a staff after pulling his hair. Dainik Bhaskar has an exclusive video of this incident. After this incident, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand sat on a protest. We spoke to that Brahmachari Sadhu. Brahmachari Sadhu Vishravanand described everything that the police did to him inside the station for one hour. Read the conversation... First police caught Brahmachari Vishravanand Shankaracharya Swami Mukteshwaranand's Sri Jyotir Math is located on Triveni Marg in Sector 4 of Prayagraj Magh Mela. Going from Sangam via pontoon bridge number 2, you reach there directly. On January 18, it was Mauni Amavasya bath. Shankaracharya was supposed to take a bath in it, but could not do so amid the 6-hour-long commotion. Police stopped them, caught and beat the sadhus with him. First, the police caught and beat Brahmachari Vishravanand, who was walking ahead. Dainik Bhaskar team reached Mukteshwaranand's camp. There we met Vishravanand. Vishravanand is from Nepal. Initially, he was associated with Goraksha Peeth in Gorakhpur, after which he joined Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand. Vishravanand is a student of the Vedas; he has Ved Vibhushan in the Atharvaveda. They say - the bath on Mauni Amavasya is considered special. Our Jagadguru has been bathing on that day. Guru Ji had also informed the administration about this. The administration people were also with them. They were walking ahead. When we reached near bridge number two, the police themselves talked to the police personnel deployed at the barricades. After this, our companions who were with us also moved the barricades aside along with the police, and we moved forward. Vishravanand says, we went and stood about 50 meters from the Sangam. There, our divine form Jagadguru was stopped. We all found this very strange. For us, our God is supreme, for us, he is most revered. We said, who are these administration people to stop the chief guru of Sanatan Dharma? This led to a dispute between us. They took our scepter and hit us with it When the scuffle started between the administration and us, I put the scepter forward. I tried to stop the crowd with it. The police snatched the scepter from me. They grabbed my braid and tossed me like a washerman tosses clothes. They dragged me away. They kept hitting me along the way, after which they pushed me into a room and locked me up. When the police were taking Vishravanand away while beating him by grabbing his hair and pulling him inside by his hair, Bhaskar's team was present there. Vishravanand says - The video is only for a short duration. They locked us inside and then started hitting me on my back with a baton. After that, they started kicking and beating with shoes. They beat me severely. Even at that time, we were worried about Guruji, wondering what was happening to him. I was folding my hands in front of the administration. Because we didn't steal anything, didn't do any hooliganism, we just came to bathe with our God. But despite this, the police didn't listen to anything and beat us badly. When Vishwanand was telling all this, he became filled with anger. His anger was visible on his face. He says, we had 13-14-year-old Bal Batuks with us. They were beaten with shoes in a closed room. I condemn such an administration that beats 13-14-year-old children with shoes. Only I know how much beating I took. When there is any bias against Sanatan, our Guruji stands up, but here the administration itself did wrong to them. The policeman who was beating was asking why become a sadhu? Vishravanand says, the policeman who was beating us was asking why become a sadhu. He was saying to our Dandi Swami why are you roaming around wearing this. Whereas this entire Magh Mela is made for sadhus and saints. The fair happens for these Shankaracharyas only. Now they are putting legal restrictions on them. They are stopping them from bathing. They are bringing them away from Sangam through the police and leaving them. At this time, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand is sitting on a dharna on the footpath outside his camp. All his supporters who are with him are also sitting there. Vishravanand says - Our Guruji sat without food and water until 1 a.m. The administration was given a chance to come and apologize, but no one came. Now our demand is directly from CM Yogi, because I myself have been going to their Goraksha Peeth. I have been sitting with him. Now he will have to take action on this matter. He should come himself and apologize to our Guru Maharaj. Besides Vishwanand, police had detained around 35 people. They were beaten up. Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand held a press conference and mentioned all this. He said that 3 people were beaten so badly that they had to be hospitalized overnight. A 14-year-old child was hit so hard on the ear that it started bleeding. Blood stains appeared on his yellow belt. Exclusive Photos-Video - Tushar Rai

stories.title: 5-day rain alert in UP, mercury drops to 6°C:Weather to remain disturbed on Republic Day; icy winds intensify cold
stories.summary: The weather has suddenly changed in UP. 10 cities, including Noida, Aligarh, and Jaunpur, are in the grip of fog. Visibility has reduced to 50 meters. More than 20 trains are running 8 to 10 hours late. Icy winds are blowing due to snowfall in the mountains. This has created a chill, and people are shivering. According to the weather department, many parts of the state may receive rainfall from January 22 to 26. This means the weather will be bad on Republic Day. Temperature is also likely to drop due to rain. On Sunday, Bulandshahr was the coldest district in the state, where the minimum temperature was recorded at 6 degrees. Rain occurred in 5 cities, including Lucknow, Barabanki, Hathras, while hail also fell in Aligarh and Lakhimpur Kheri. Now know the condition of cities Why the weather changed, know here The effect of the active western disturbance in northwest India is now clearly visible in Uttar Pradesh as well. Due to this, cloud movement has increased in many parts of the state. There has been a change in wind direction. Where easterly winds were blowing earlier, now westerly winds are taking their place. This has increased moisture in the atmosphere, and conditions for rain are forming in some places. Rain beneficial for wheat-lentils According to agricultural experts, this rain is beneficial for wheat, lentils, and chickpea crops, but mustard and potato crops may be damaged. Farmers have been advised to keep an eye on weather updates and spray pesticides on crops when needed to prevent damage. How will the weather be for 3 days

stories.title: People kept recording videos, engineer son died:Noida father says 80 rescuers arrived, not one entered water to save his son
stories.summary: 'Help me... help me... the son was screaming like this. People were making VIDEOS, no one was doing anything to save him. I scolded them. Still, no attempts were made. My son died needlessly.' This is the pain of Rajkumar Mehta, father of Noida engineer Yuvraj... The father watched his son, Yuvraj, drown in the car before his eyes. Rajkumar says there were 80 employees at the scene. No one got into the water. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is also angry about the accident. Noida Authority CEO Lokesh M. has been removed. The SIT has been given the responsibility to bring forward every face responsible for the accident. A report has been demanded within 5 days. Now, let's hear from Father Rajkumar about the negligence in the accident and rescue on the night of January 16. First read what happened on the night of the accident... 12:20 AM (Night) Call came, please save me, father says - I ran as soon as I heard Father Rajkumar says - Around 12:20 at night on Friday, I was lying on the bed. Suddenly, I got a call from my son, Yuvraj. He was about to come home, so I couldn't understand why he was calling me. I picked up the phone. A frightened voice was heard from the other end. He said- Papa...Papa I have fallen into the drain, I don't want to die. Please save me. After hearing this, I ran out in the clothes I was wearing. Before leaving the society, I typed a message and posted it on the society's group, so that help could be found. The drain my son mentioned was 200 meters away from our society. I ran to that drain. Here, I kept trying to search for my son in the thick fog and darkness for 30 minutes, shouting to get a response. Then I felt that I was searching in the wrong place. 12:30 PM Said to people making videos - Please save my son After this, I reached towards the road cut, where construction of a building was incomplete. A pit was dug here for the basement. Upon reaching there, I started shouting, hearing my voice, my son also screamed... save... save. After hearing the voice of "Help Me", I understood that my son had fallen here. I went a little further ahead, and through the fog I saw that the car was in the water and my son was lying on its roof. He was about 50 to 60 feet away from the road. He was slowly sinking. He kept turning his mobile phone light on and off so that those standing on the shore would know he was alive. I called Dial-112. It was around 12:30 at that time. I was watching him sink in front of me. There were other people there too, but no one was helping. Some people were making videos, I told them - Please don't make videos, help my son. Understand how the search operation was conducted 12:50 PM Crane reached 30 feet, and Yuvraj was 50 feet away Around 12:45 AM, police and a fire truck with Dial-112 arrived at the scene. By then, the fog had become dense. Visibility was almost zero. First, the police and fire team tried to rescue by throwing a rope. However, the rope was not reaching Yuvraj. Some police officers were saying the water is very cold, and how to get in. Some were saying there could be iron rods below the site. After this, a crane was called. But even the crane could not reach Yuvraj. It was only going up to 30-40 feet. No one present was trying to get into the water. The father said that the pit was probably 15 to 20 feet deep, so if divers were there, his son's life could have been saved. 1:45 PM SDRF called, but car submerged The SDRF team arrived at 1:15 AM. They also did not have adequate resources. Everyone was screaming save him, do something. Father says - I was ready to get into the water myself, but the police didn't let me go forward. Around 1:45 AM, Yuvraj's car was completely submerged in water. Yuvraj, who was lying on top of it, also disappeared into the water. We could only watch this happen. 80 personnel conducted search operation for 2 hours Around quarter to two, the NDRF team arrived. 30 personnel from SDRF and NDRF had already arrived. 50 personnel from the police and fire department were present there. About 80 people conducted the rescue and search operation. The team went into the water with the help of a searchlight, crane, and ladder. After 2 hours of effort, Yuvraj's body was recovered around 4:15. He was taken to the hospital, where doctors declared that he had stopped breathing. Fire department personnel who descended wearing life jackets were facing a lot of difficulty because there was no visibility. The hydraulic platform also could not help. The car could not be pulled out of the water. Father said - Authority is responsible, complaints about the spot were made, everyone kept sleeping Father Rajkumar Mehta blamed the Noida Authority for his son's death. He said - Society people had complained many times before. There are no lights or reflectors installed here; accidents can happen, but no arrangements were made. Even the drain that broke due to a truck collision 15 days ago was not repaired. Now read the situation from ground zero on January 19 Barricading was done, but no lights, reflectors were installed After understanding the full story of the accident from father Rajkumar Mehta, the Dainik Bhaskar team reached the ATS Le-Grandios turn near Noida Sector 150. This is where that deadly turn is, where the accident happened. We saw that barricading had been done at the place where the accident occurred. But no lights or reflectors were installed. A crowd had gathered, and we were told that 10 thousand people commute through here every day. Double basement dug and left incomplete We closely examined the spot, and the drainage boundary was broken. About 15 days ago, a truck had collided with this wall. It was not repaired. Ahead of this is the under-construction plot SC-02 of Sector-150. This plot belongs to MG Wish Town. Double basement work was done here and left incomplete. Water kept accumulating here due to drainage leakage. Due to water being filled for a long time, the soil here had become like a swamp. There was only 1 board here, which read - Sector 150. To understand the accident spot, we talked to many people there. It came to light that builder MZ Viztown Planners Private Limited and Lotus Green had gotten the map of this site approved by the authority. Commercial shops were to be built here. The basement was dug, but then work was stopped. Water filled up this same plot. Not just plots, most are in the same condition We started observing that there are societies on both sides of the road. Wherever empty plots were visible, the condition was the same. The plots were excavated and left as is. Most had water filled up to 30 to 40 feet. There was no drainage system at all. Half-finished flats were built with exposed rebars. No construction was taking place. Now read what people present at the scene think Vijay Mehrotra, who lives in Noida, says - A week ago, four or five of us friends were coming back from a party. We stopped right near the drain. We couldn't see where the road was. A few days ago, a truck also got stuck here. That's what broke the boundary. If the boundary hadn't been broken, this child wouldn't have gone inside, would have stopped right here. The boundary wasn't repaired. Action, what happened... Knowledge Park Police filed a case against 2 builder companies, MJ Vistaown and Lotus Green, on January 18. Father Rajkumar Mehta has filed the complaint. FIR has been registered against builders under these sections- After this incident, 2 events occurred on the evening of January 19- First. Authority CEO removed Junior Engineer Noida Authority Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Lokesh M. terminated the services of Junior Engineer Naveen Kumar with immediate effect. Show cause notices were issued to concerned officers. All departments were asked to monitor security arrangements around under-construction projects in their areas. Second. stories.title: 'Indestructible Kashi itself will become cause of BJP’s-destruction'- Akhilesh Yadav:Priyanka calls Manikarnika Ghat demolition grave sin
stories.summary: The demolition and redevelopment work at Manikarnika Ghat, one of the most sacred cremation grounds in Kashi, has triggered a major political controversy. The Congress and the Samajwadi Party (SP) have strongly criticised the BJP-led government, alleging that centuries-old religious and cultural heritage is being destroyed in the name of development. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav said that “indestructible Kashi itself will become the cause of BJP’s destruction”, accusing the ruling party of acting purely for monetary gain. Sharp questions raised by Priyanka Gandhi Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and party president Mallikarjun Kharge also raised sharp questions over the project. Controversy regarding ₹25 crore redevelopment project First see 2 pictures... Priyanka Gandhi: “Erasing Cultural Identity” Priyanka Gandhi wrote on X that it was “extremely unfortunate” to run bulldozers over a centuries-old religious and cultural site like Manikarnika Ghat. She said the ghat holds immense religious significance and is deeply linked to the legacy of Lokmata Ahilyabai Holkar. Calling the demolition a “grave sin”, Priyanka alleged that heritage sites are being destroyed for the commercial benefit of a few. She further claimed that several ancient temples in Banaras had already been demolished earlier in the name of renovation and warned that attempts to erase Kashi’s religious, spiritual and cultural identity must stop immediately. Kharge questions the PM Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge directly questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi, asking whether business interests were driving such redevelopment projects. He posed two questions on behalf of the public. First, could renovation and beautification not have been carried out while preserving the original heritage? He cited examples such as the removal of statues of Mahatma Gandhi and Dr B R Ambedkar from Parliament premises and changes made to the Jallianwala Bagh Memorial. Second, Kharge asked why centuries-old statues were reduced to debris instead of being preserved in a museum. Referring to the Prime Minister’s earlier remarks on the Ganga, Kharge said the ghats of Banaras are the city’s identity and questioned whether public access to them was being compromised. He also raised concerns for devotees who come to Kashi in their final days seeking salvation. Akhilesh Yadav’s attack Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav accused the BJP of showing disrespect towards the legacy of Rajmata Punyashlok Devi Ahilyabai Holkar. He said no true believer would tolerate insult to her statues or to Kashi’s Sanatani heritage. According to Akhilesh, the BJP neither cares for Kashi nor its residents, nor for the historical personalities associated with it. He claimed greed was the sole motive behind the project. How the controversy began... Project Background Prime Minister Modi laid the foundation stone for the redevelopment project in 2023. Work was halted for around 18 months due to floods and has now resumed at a faster pace. Both Manikarnika and Harishchandra Ghats are being redeveloped. The permanent ghat structure was demolished using heavy machinery, following which allegations emerged that a 300-year-old stone structure had been removed. Ahilyabai Trust Raises Objections Yashwant Holkar, chairman of the Maharani Ahilyabai Trust, visited Gurudham Temple to perform purification rituals before broken statues of the queen. He said four statues installed at the corners of Manikarnika Ghat’s shrine were damaged, with two found broken. Calling the act unforgivable, he said the Indore royal family had never imagined such treatment of Ahilyabai’s legacy in Kashi. The Trust has demanded that missing parts of the statues be returned within seven days and insisted that redevelopment cannot proceed without its consent, citing Supreme Court-granted conservation rights. Dom Raja Family Dismisses Claims Vishwanath Chaudhary of Kashi’s Dom Raja family rejected allegations of idol destruction, calling them misleading. He said beautification of the ghat was requested by his own family and approved by the Prime Minister. He added that idols had been safely removed and would be reinstalled at their original locations after completion of work, emphasising that an organised and well-maintained ghat serves the interest of devotees from across India and abroad.

stories.title: Sword distribution accused Pinky Chaudhary welcomed with massive rally:Slogan shouting traffic violations seen as convoy of SUVs moves through Ghaziabad
stories.summary: A major procession took place outside Dasna Jail in Ghaziabad on Thursday, following the release of Hindu Raksha Dal’s national president Pinky Chaudhary and her son Harsh Chaudhary. Hundreds of supporters gathered as the leaders were freed in a case related to the distribution of swords. The convoy, stretching up to 20 km, saw boys hanging from car windows and fireworks being set off. Vehicles in the procession included multiple SUVs such as Scorpios, Thars, and Fortuners. Now see 4 pictures... Grand Procession from Jail to Office Immediately after their release, Pinky Chaudhary led a procession from Dasna Jail to the Hindu Raksha Dal office in Shalimar Garden. She recorded a video from a moving car, saying: “Ram… Ram, we have come from jail. We will do religious work again. My companions are taking me, you also see.” The video shows supporters leaning out of cars, chanting slogans, and honking as they moved through the city. At the office, Chaudhary met with party workers, receiving a hero’s welcome from supporters. Bail granted after sword distribution case Pinky Chaudhary had filed a bail application in Ghaziabad district court for a case related to distributing swords door-to-door. On 14 January, the court accepted her bail, and the release was processed the following day. During her release, Chaudhary also recorded videos of the convoy celebrating her return. Swords distributed in Ghaziabad The controversy traces back to 29 September 2025, when a 21-second video surfaced showing Hindu Raksha Dal members distributing swords and axes in Shalimar Garden, Ghaziabad. The recipients were told the weapons were for the protection of their sisters and daughters, and to defend themselves in case of a situation like Bangladesh. Each sword was touched to the forehead, followed by chants of “Jai Shri Ram”. Following the video, police arrested Pinky Chaudhary and her son on 6 January, along with 10 others. Even those who unknowingly received swords, including a society guard, were taken into custody. Mixed reactions from locals Some recipients of the swords claim they were unaware of the consequences. Bhavana, whose husband was given a sword at home, said: “He has no connection with them. There is an atmosphere of fear. Everyone should have weapons. Look at what is happening in Bangladesh. We are not safe here.” Another local, Amit, who had a brother among those arrested, stated: “We had nothing to do with this. Just because something happened elsewhere doesn’t mean it will happen here. The organisation is doing wrong, and there should be no talk of Hindu-Muslim or caste issues.” Pinky Chaudhary and family defend actions In a video posted on 3 January, Pinky Chaudhary said she would respond strongly to any cases filed against her. Her daughter, Karuna Chaudhary, justified the sword distribution, claiming that “every house should have a Pinky Chaudhary for the safety of sisters and daughters.” Organisation’s history of controversies Hindu Raksha Dal has a long record of controversies. The group has previously been involved in attacks on Muslims, communal sloganeering, and issuing inflammatory statements. After the Pahalgam terror attack, the organisation released a video threatening Kashmiri Muslims in Dehradun. In August 2024, Pinky Chaudhary and others allegedly attacked Muslims in a Ghaziabad slum, calling them Bangladeshis. Cases were registered, and she was arrested but later released on bail. In August 2021, Chaudhary had also made communal statements during a rally at Jantar Mantar in Delhi, resulting in brief detention.

stories.title: First newborn girl in family sparks huge celebration in Hamirpur:13 Scorpio convoy, DJ drums mark joyous arrival
stories.summary: A family marked the birth of a baby girl with an elaborate celebration, taking out a convoy of 13 Scorpio SUVs in Hamirpur. The cars, decorated with blue balloons, moved along the highway with DJ music, band and drum beats, as family members danced and sang their way home. On reaching home, the women of the family gave the newborn a grand welcome with band music. Baby girl born on Tuesday The baby girl was born on Tuesday, and her arrival is special as a daughter was born in the family after one generation. A video of the celebration has also surfaced. The incident is from Mohalla Fattepur in Maudaha town. First see 3 pictures... Family waited years for a daughter Anjum Parvez alias Raju lives in Mohalla Fattepur, Maudaha. His father is a retired Army personnel, while Raju runs a flour mill from home. His wife’s name is Nikhat Fatima. Raju is the eldest of four brothers and has no sisters. The other brothers are unmarried. The family had been hoping for the birth of a daughter for a long time. Baby girl born two days ago Nikhat Fatima was admitted to a hospital about one kilometre from home for delivery. On Tuesday night, she gave birth to a baby girl. As soon as the doctors informed the family, their happiness knew no bounds. After Nikhat was discharged, the family decided to celebrate the occasion in a big way. A convoy of 13 Scorpios travelled from the hospital to their home, all decorated with balloons. DJ music, drum beats and dancing accompanied the long line of vehicles throughout the journey. Raju and Nikhat travelled in one vehicle with their newborn, while other cars carried relatives and family members. Neighbours also joined the celebrations on their arrival. Grandfather blesses granddaughter with ₹5,000 The baby’s grandfather and family elder, Ruknuddin, a retired BSF personnel, welcomed his granddaughter by giving a blessing of ₹5,000. Holding the baby in his lap, he said the little girl had brought happiness and prosperity to the family. “All my illness disappeared,” says grandmother The baby’s grandmother, Roshni, expressed her joy, saying that all her illness seemed to have vanished with the arrival of her granddaughter. She said the birth of the girl had brought new energy and happiness into the household, especially as the family had waited so long for a daughter. Doctor calls it a rare and positive example Dr Anshu Mishra, from the hospital where Nikhat delivered, said that in the last three years in Hamirpur district, she had not seen such an open and enthusiastic celebration for the birth of a girl child. She added that such celebrations can help change social attitudes, sending a strong message that daughters are not a burden, but a source of pride and happiness.

stories.title: Cockroach spotted in noodles at Lucknow’s Robot Restaurant:Children panic during birthday party; family alleges negligence from management
stories.summary: A cockroach was found in a plate of noodles at Lucknow’s well-known Robot Restaurant in Aliganj on Wednesday evening. A birthday party was underway at the restaurant when the incident occurred. The family had ordered noodles for children, and a cockroach was spotted immediately while the dish was being served. Family raises issue with manager The family raised the issue with the restaurant manager. However, instead of accepting responsibility, the manager initially offered to replace the noodles in an apparent attempt to downplay the matter. This further upset the family, who later complained with the Food and Drug Administration (FSDA). Now read the full matter in detail... Cockroach spotted while noodles were being served According to the complainant, Ashutosh, it was his daughter’s birthday on Wednesday. He had reached the Robot Restaurant in Aliganj with family members and friends in the evening. After placing orders, noodles were served for the children. As the noodles were being placed on the children’s plates, a cockroach was clearly visible in one of the servings. Ashutosh said the children were frightened on seeing the cockroach, and the family panicked. He added that the situation could have turned serious if a child had accidentally consumed the contaminated food. Family upset by manager’s response Ashutosh said he immediately complained to the restaurant manager, but the response was disappointing. The manager allegedly tried to brush aside the issue and suggested resolving it by placing a fresh order. This response angered the family members. Although the manager later apologised, the family said they were deeply hurt by the initial attitude and handling of the complaint. Complaint lodged with Food Safety Department Ashutosh has filed a formal complaint with the Food Safety and Drug Administration regarding the incident. He has demanded strict action against the restaurant, stating that negligence of this kind poses a serious risk to public health and should not be taken lightly. Incident raises concerns over food safety monitoring Other customers present at the restaurant at the time also expressed their displeasure. Many said such negligence was unexpected from a large and modern establishment like Robot Restaurant. The incident has raised serious questions about the restaurant’s hygiene standards as well as the effectiveness of food safety monitoring by the authorities.

stories.title: 8-year-old son gets mother’s post-mortem done in Etah:Sits cries beside her body; says, 'Relatives will kill me'
stories.summary: In Etah, Uttar Pradesh, an eight-year-old boy was seen sitting beside his mother’s body during her post-mortem, crying inconsolably as he looked at her shroud-covered corpse and wiped his tears. The scene moved policemen and others present, with one person consoling the child by placing a hand on his shoulder. The boy’s father, who was HIV-positive, died a year ago, and his mother has now also died of the same disease, leaving the child alone. With no one initially coming forward to carry the body, relatives arrived only after 17 hours, allowing the inquest to be completed. An inspector has taken responsibility for performing the woman’s last rites. The child has also expressed fear for his life, alleging a threat from his own relatives. He said, 'My family members want to usurp my land. My life is in danger.' See Photos... Case details The case is from Nagla Dheeraj village in Jaithra police station area. A 45-year-old woman lived at home with her 8-year-old son and 13-year-old daughter. A year ago, her husband died of HIV. Since then, the woman was also ill. For 8 days, the woman was undergoing treatment at Veerangana Avanti Bai Medical College. She passed away at 10 PM on January 14. After his mother's death, the eight-year-old son reached the district headquarters alone at 7 AM with his mother's body for a post-mortem. Child sat crying in front of his mother's dead body He sat on the floor beside his mother’s body in the post-mortem house, sobbing continuously. Police waited to prepare the inquest report, but even five people were not available as witnesses. After receiving information, some relatives arrived around 3 pm, following which the post-mortem process began. Expressed threat to life from family The child said, No member of his family has come forward to help him. Everyone is after his 5 bigha property. He fears for his life from his family. Treated mother alone, even in Delhi The son stated that ever since his mother fell ill, he had been solely responsible for her treatment. He took his mother for treatment to Lohia Hospital in Farrukhabad, Hallett Hospital in Kanpur, and even to Delhi. For about eight days, his mother's health had significantly worsened, leading to her admission to Veerangana Avantibai Medical College in Etah. No one cared for ailing mother Ultimately, the mother passed away during treatment. The son claims that despite knowing about his mother's illness, no relative or kin bothered to check on her. Now, upon receiving the news of his mother's death, other family members, including his uncle, arrived. Revenue officials have been dispatched for the last rites, which will be conducted under the supervision of the administration. Jaithra Police Station in-charge Ritesh Thakur has taken charge of the deceased woman's last rites.

stories.title: Transgender leader Sonam Chishti attacked in UP:Gunpoint abduction, beating forced haircut alleged; CM Yogi urged to intervene
stories.summary: Transgender leader Sonam Chishti, who held the rank of Minister of State in the Yogi Adityanath government, was allegedly kidnapped at gunpoint, assaulted and forcibly had her hair cut in Uttar Pradesh’s Ghazipur district. The incident reportedly took place when she had gone to collect congratulatory offerings along with members of the transgender community. The state president of the transgender community has demanded strict action from Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, alleging police inaction and refusal to register a complaint. Incident reported from Ghazipur police station area According to Iqbal Kinnar, state president of the transgender community, the incident occurred on the night of November 28. He said Sonam Chishti, a former minister of state rank, had come to meet him and later accompanied his group to collect congratulatory gifts at a wedding in the Ghazipur area, a traditional practice within the community. Group of 20 men allegedly attacked, Sonam taken away Iqbal alleged that while they were returning, transgenders from a rival group, accompanied by around 20 men armed with sticks and pistols, surrounded them and launched an attack. Two transgenders were seriously injured, one of whom suffered a fractured hand and is undergoing treatment in Kanpur. During the assault, Sonam Chishti was allegedly abducted and taken away. Iqbal claimed she was later found unconscious and abandoned. Allegation of police refusing to register complaint Iqbal Kinnar said complaints were submitted to the District Magistrate and Superintendent of Police, alleging that outsiders were falsely changing their gender identity, attacking local transgender leaders and forcefully taking over their positions. He claimed the police station refused to accept their complaint, prompting an appeal to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for justice. Police deny receiving any complaint Station in-charge Hanuman Pratap Singh said the police had no information about the incident. He stated that no written complaint had been received so far and assured that appropriate action would be taken once a complaint is filed. What the viral video shows In the video linked to the incident, a transgender person holding scissors identifies herself as Sanya Nayak from the Bilanda area of Ghazipur. She is seen questioning another transgender person, who identifies herself as Sonam Nayak. Sonam is seated on a cot with two transgenders sitting beside her, while another person standing behind forcibly cuts her hair with scissors. It is claimed that Sonam had come from Sultanpur along with Iqbal and Babli Nayak. Who Is Sonam Chishti? Previous controversies and public statements Sonam Chishti has previously made headlines for questioning her own party in Bareilly, alleging that bulldozers were being used against the homes of the poor. During a meeting in Kanpur, she had threatened to resign, stating that issues faced by the transgender community were being ignored. In Aligarh, she had demanded the scrapping of pensions for MPs and MLAs. She had also sought a BJP ticket from Sultanpur ahead of the Lok Sabha elections, but the party fielded Maneka Gandhi, who eventually lost to the Samajwadi Party candidate.

stories.title: 'I don’t want an impotent man,' says wife:Kanpur man ends life after consuming poison at in-laws’ doorstep; married 2.5 years ago
stories.summary: In Kanpur, a young man died by suicide after consuming poison outside his in-laws’ house in the Chakeri police station area. He had gone to persuade his wife, but she shut the door on him and did not respond despite repeated knocking. At around 3:40 pm on Wednesday, he made a final call to his wife, which went unanswered. After this, the man consumed poison in his auto and returned home, where his condition worsened. He was taken to Kanshiram Hospital and later referred to Hallett Hospital, where doctors declared him dead late Wednesday night. According to the police, the couple had been in a relationship for 8 years. Two and a half years ago, they got married in a temple. Four months ago, after an argument with her husband, the wife had gone to her parental home. The WhatsApp chat between the husband and wife has come to light. In it, the wife wrote to her husband, I don't want a coward, a cheater like you. I hate... you, your name, your hypocritical actions. Is this the first time you're eating outside food because of me? Complete story of love, marriage, and suicide, read in 4 points 1. Married without family’s consent: Vikram Kewat (25), an auto driver from Anand Vihar under Hanumant Vihar police station area, was the only son of Jai Kumar, who lives with his wife Isha and four daughters, Chinchhi, Pooja, Sanno and Shalu. Vikram had been in a relationship with Riya, a resident of Ramadevi’s Delhi Pulia, for eight years. About two-and-a-half years ago, they married in a temple without informing the family, and later lived in a rented house in Damodar Nagar. The father alleged Riya never allowed the family to meet Vikram. 2. Contact cut off after marriage: Jai Kumar said Riya blocked the family’s numbers on Vikram’s phone. After marriage, domestic disputes arose, and about four months ago Riya left Vikram and went to her parental home. Despite repeated attempts, Vikram was unable to persuade her to return. 3. Repeated suicide attempts alleged: According to the father, Vikram, distressed by marital issues, had attempted suicide four to five times earlier. About 15 days ago, Riya allegedly came to their Damodar Nagar house, took jewellery and Rs 1 lakh in cash, and returned to her maternal home. Vikram later found his number blocked again. 4. Poison consumed after call unanswered: Jai Kumar said that on Wednesday, around 3 pm, Vikram went by auto to Riya’s house to convince her, but she did not open the door. At 3:40 pm, he called her again, but the call went unanswered. Vikram then consumed poison in his parked auto. Around 4:15 pm, he returned home, where his condition worsened. He was taken to Kanshiram Hospital and later referred to Hallett Hospital, where he died late at night. Husband and wife argued on WhatsApp After Vikram's death, his family checked his mobile. They found some WhatsApp messages showing an argument between Vikram and Riya. Chakeri Police Station in-charge Ajay Prakash Mishra said, The body has been sent for post-mortem. The family has not yet filed a complaint.
